scope: Read-only applicability and performance audit; no GPU, serving, model loading or service-state operations

recommendation.decision: Retain the v0.33-pinned kernel 0.1.15.4 for the primary candidate; do not upgrade solely for an assumed current-profile speedup
recommendation.reason: Source tracing finds no automatic benefit from v0.1.17's prominent performance changes on the current eager, dense Qwen, Xe2 B70, custom-KVarN path. The release does add useful correctness and coverage work, but those are not measured speedups here. Its Torch 2.15 and packaging migration belongs to a separately qualified experiment if pursued.
recommendation.certainty: Call-path applicability is source-verified; total performance, memory and TTFT remain unmeasured
recommendation.intermediate_release: v0.1.16.4 also changes Torch to 2.15 and does not contain the token-aware QK kernel change or the adaptive FlashAttention change. Its additions primarily address other model shapes, MoE, FP8, RecoverSSM and M-RoPE coverage. Earlier 0.1.16/0.1.16.2 avoid that final Torch bump but present no clear benefit to the active paths identified here. No intermediate upgrade is recommended on this evidence.

active_profile.device: Intel Arc Pro B70, Xe2/BMG AOT
active_profile.target_compute: BF16 dense W4A16 compressed-tensors; hybrid full attention plus GDN
active_profile.draft_cache: BF16 sliding window 2048, two speculative tokens
active_profile.multimodal: Two images, no video, fixed 200704 pixel budget per image
active_profile.sharing: Embedding/STT workers disabled; GPU headroom retained for Jellyfin

kernel_changes.change: Token-aware heads_per_sg selection for native fused_qk_norm_rope
kernel_changes.upstream_evidence: csrc/fused_qknorm_rope.cpp::select_heads_per_sg tunes num_tokens * total_qk_heads and explicitly says thresholds were tuned on B70. Upstream adds bit-identical forced-variant tests and a benchmark gate.
kernel_changes.current_profile_applicability: No automatic use. vLLM's native _C.fused_qk_norm_rope call lives in compilation/passes/fusion/qk_norm_rope_fusion.py. enforce_eager sets CompilationMode.NONE. The target Qwen3NextAttention._project_qkv_gate calls the separate Triton fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope_gate, not this native operator. DFlash2Qwen3DecoderLayer inherits DFlashQwen3DecoderLayer; its attention uses eager RMSNorm and rotary_emb calls.
kernel_changes.action: Do not attribute upstream kernel benchmark gains to this host. A future compiled or explicitly fused draft experiment needs proof of operator dispatch, correctness and whole-service measurements. Do not enable graphs just to reach it; KVarN's XPU beta rejects graph mode.

kernel_changes.change: Ragged and padded speculative query support in FlashAttention split-K decode redirection
kernel_changes.upstream_evidence: vllm_xpu_kernels/flash_attn_interface.py::_spec_decode_varlen_fwd uses searchsorted on device cu_seqlens_q instead of a uniform query-length assumption; flash_attn_varlen_func now accepts nonuniform small causal paged batches.
kernel_changes.current_profile_applicability: The KVarN target verifies through its native compact-cache path. KVarNAttentionImpl._flash_varlen passes dense unpaged K/V, so this new block_table-dependent redirect is not used there. BF16 draft FlashAttention may use its wrapper, but fixed two-proposal drafting does not by itself establish a newly ragged workload or improvement over the existing uniform fast path.
kernel_changes.action: No current-profile speedup established. Adaptive verification requires more than this kernel upgrade.

kernel_changes.change: GDN null-state skipping, DS conv-state layout, and 64-bit conv-state offsets
kernel_changes.current_profile_applicability: Valuable correctness changes. Null-state handling targets graph padding, while this host uses eager execution and its adapter trims request padding. DS layout support fixes a different layout than the existing qualified SD path. Wider offsets address sufficiently high block-index times stride; the independent recurrent pool is small, unlike a large shared attention-sized pool. None establishes a speed benefit or invalidates the separate fresh-state producer/consumer barrier.
kernel_changes.local_patch_implication: The fresh-state barrier file csrc/xpu/gdn_attn/xe_2/chunk_gated_delta_rule_kernels_xe2.hpp has no old-base-to-v0.1.17 diff. These newer changes are not evidence to drop the local barrier or re-enable historically unstable tiled prefill. Per-commit audit remains authoritative.
kernel_changes.action: Keep in the correctness watchlist and future graph/layout qualification; no blanket workaround removal.

kernel_changes.change: Xe3P grouped GEMM, fused routed/shared MoE, FP8/MXFP8 fixes, MLA context parallelism, head-size 72 and expanded attention presets
kernel_changes.current_profile_applicability: Xe3P differs from this BMG/Xe2 build. The target and draft are dense W4A16 rather than routed MoE, and KVarN is not FP8/MLA. MoonViT head-size72 and other model-specific configs do not match the active target's H256 attention. These additions must not silently broaden the host AOT selection.
kernel_changes.action: No current-profile performance claim. Preserve explicit BMG and host kernel coverage.

kernel_changes.change: Native interleaved M-RoPE support, present in 0.1.16 lineage
kernel_changes.current_profile_applicability: The relevant target uses fused Triton gated QK norm/RoPE. v0.33 MRotaryEmbedding.forward_xpu delegates to forward_cuda, whose 2D path calls triton_mrope. New native SYCL M-RoPE coverage therefore does not establish an automatic benefit to this eager host.
kernel_changes.action: Treat as coverage for other paths, not a reason to repin this candidate.

v033_host_opportunities.feature: DFlash/DSpark stop dropping the last prefix-cache block
v033_host_opportunities.applicability: Directly relevant to the active DFlash2 plus hybrid Mamba-aligned prefix-cache workload, including RAM-prefix replay when the local connector follows upstream group ownership.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Preserve the upstream fix during rebase; compare matched warm-prefix and RAM-restored requests. Measure recomputed tokens, TTFT and cache correctness at block/context boundaries. No new serving flag needed.
v033_host_opportunities.performance_status: Expected reduction of avoidable replay work by source semantics; magnitude not measured.

v033_host_opportunities.applicability: Current toolCallParser=qwen3_xml resolves through tool_parsers/__init__.py to Qwen3EngineToolParser, then registered_adapters.py to Qwen3Parser. The changed parser is on the configured path.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Retain the existing parser setting. Test long string arguments and escaped/structured values through the actual gateway. Compare time to first useful tool-argument chunk and parser CPU time. Upstream's 12KB benchmark is not the host's measured speedup and is not model-prefill TTFT.
v033_host_opportunities.performance_status: Automatic applicable parser improvement; local measurement pending.

v033_host_opportunities.feature: DFlash draft rows no longer consume target scheduler token budget
v033_host_opportunities.applicability: Direct DFlash configuration path. The current four-request/two-proposal limit is far below a 2048-token draft-pass cap, so major capacity claims would be overstated.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Preserve upstream logic; compare mixed prefill/decode at four requests and record scheduled target tokens and prefill latency.

v033_host_opportunities.applicability: The single-engine host can now test it. Interval >1 intentionally gives existing decoders uninterrupted steps by deferring all prefill work, including already admitted chunks.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Keep default 1 for the qualification baseline. Optional matched interval 1 versus 2 experiment under one active decode plus one long prompt; promote only if inter-token latency improves enough to justify increased prompt TTFT. It is not a general TTFT improvement.

v033_host_opportunities.applicability: qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py::_resolve_gdn_prefill_backend reads additional_config.gdn_prefill_backend; auto still chooses available SYCL. Triton offers an alternate implementation to compare.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Optional isolated experiment after baseline qualification, using additional-config gdn_prefill_backend=triton. Validate fresh-state output, cached continuation, speculative rollback and RAM restore before considering performance. Do not infer equivalence or retire local native fixes from the existence of this toggle.

v033_host_opportunities.applicability: Not a ready-to-enable feature for this hybrid custom backend. GDNAttentionBackend.is_ssm returns true and inherits supports_device_cpu_query_lens_mismatch=false. The adaptive manager rejects such backends. KVarNMetadataBuilder reports UNIFORM_BATCH without a demonstrated variable-length bound, and XPU KVarN explicitly rejects graph mode.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Leave enable_adaptive_verification false. A future implementation needs verified variable-length GDN/KVarN ownership and admission semantics, not merely kernel v0.1.17.

v033_host_opportunities.feature: Upstream CPU offload pinning, shm partitioning and capacity metrics
v033_host_opportunities.applicability: IndependentCPUOffloadingWorker allocates one pinned uint8 host tensor and performs its own bounded byte-pool transfers. Generic CPUOffloadingSpec improvements do not automatically optimize this custom worker.
v033_host_opportunities.action: Audit integration and capacity metric reporting separately; do not claim RAM savings from generic CPU offload changes without observing the custom worker's allocation.

retain: 128K context and 0.93 utilization preserve the documented shared-GPU headroom; lowering context alone would not reserve GPU memory
Four request slots share the recorded 149888 attention-token pool; do not describe this as four concurrent full contexts
8GiB RAM prefix tier, pinned target/draft revisions, explicit BF16 draft KV, and bounded image processing
2048 batched-token limit: the current KVarN XPU speculative configuration explicitly guards max_num_batched_tokens<=2048; do not casually recommend4096 or8192
Eager mode: this is an explicit KVarN support constraint, not an accidentally forgotten graph optimization
host_configuration_assessment.still_unresolved: The documented long-idle stall needs a natural before/after idle snapshot. MemorySwapMax=0 is not proof of cause or protection for every GPU-driver allocation. Do not replace that investigation with keepalive traffic or a speculative cache-size change.
host_configuration_assessment.memory_claim: No source-audit evidence of a new automatic VRAM reduction for the configured KVarN path. Preserve current budget until candidate allocation and shared-GPU behavior are measured.

qualification_order: Build and run the v0.33 + audited0.1.15.4 baseline at the exact current host profile after the user frees the GPU
Run native GDN/KVarN regression coverage, short structured answers, vision, speculative rejection/rollback, cache reset, warm-prefix/RAM replay and128K boundaries
Matched old/new profile comparison at1,2,4 requests: cold/warm/RAM-restored TTFT, inter-token latency, output tokens/s, acceptance, preemption, actual GPU/RAM allocation and correctness
Exercise long XML tool-argument streaming through the gateway separately from model TTFT
Only then test optional prefill interval2 or GDN Triton as one-variable changes; retain the current limit/profile on regressions
If separately investigating newer kernels, compare an otherwise identical fully matched Torch/toolchain pair and prove which native ops actually execute before attributing gains
